# Project: Marketing Agency Website

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 15 with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion

## Design Principles
- Use neuromarketing principles for conversion optimization
- Color scheme: white, cyan (#06b6d4), and silver (#c0c0c0)
- Focus on clear visual hierarchy with generous white space
- Maximum 2 fonts, maximum 3 colors
- Headlines: 48-64px
- Section spacing: minimum 120px

## Conversion Best Practices
- Strong value propositions, not feature lists
- Multiple CTAs leading to /angebote (offers page)
- Sticky "Projekt starten" button
- Social proof and trust elements
- Scarcity elements where appropriate
- Problem-solution blocks
- Measurable case studies

## Code Style
- Use "use client" directive for components with interactivity
- Implement smooth scroll animations with Framer Motion
- Mobile-first responsive design
- No emoji, no animated icons
- Clean, professional aesthetic
